subject: Interview staffing: succession plan & interviewer shadow rotations
body:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-08 08:15 AM -0700
Subject: Interview staffing: succession plan & interviewer shadow rotations

Hi team,

We have a slightly unusual window next week for the Senior Infra candidate loop for Emma Liu. Three of the usual interviewers are out across the 10/11-10/13 window (PTO and an onsite offsite). I'd like to propose a short succession plan so we don't lose momentum:

- Primary ask: identify 2 backup interviewers who can take the final technical loop on short notice.
- Secondary: set up shadow rotations so each backup shadows one live interview before owning a loop.

Estimated impact:
- 2 candidate slots on 10/12 at risk if we don't reassign.
- Candidate is in final stage and has competing offers; timeline matters.

I attached Emma's latest resume and a quick shadow schedule I sketched. Can you reply with availability and whether you can be a backup? If we can map backups by EOD tomorrow I'll update Greenhouse and calendar invites.

Thanks,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Hiring Manager, Core Infra
Redwood Inference

-------------------------
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-08 11:03 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Interview staffing: succession plan & interviewer shadow rotations

Thanks for the heads up, Connor. I can take one of the 10/12 slots and I'm happy to do the shadow on 10/11 afternoon.

Proposed plan from my side:
- Laura to cover technical deep dive on 10/12 at 10:00 PT (backup 1)
- Marissa to cover system design if you want her to (backup 2)
- I'll join the 10/11 3pm interview as shadow to make the handoff smooth.

Notes:
- I'll need the panel debrief template filled in after each loop so we keep notes consistent. Can you attach that in the calendar invite?

Laura Bennett
Senior Engineering Manager

-------------------------
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-08 11:37 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Interview staffing: succession plan & interviewer shadow rotations

I can do system design on 10/12 at 2pm PT. Also fine to shadow on 10/11; if the 3pm slot is full, I'm flexible at 4:30. I attached an updated shadow schedule with my availability.

Two quick asks:
1) If either backup has a hard conflict at the last minute, can we define the fallback pool (people comfortable with multiple roles)?
2) Can we brief the candidate that one interviewer might be swapped due to PTO, so they aren't surprised? I can handle that note in the candidate comms after you approve.

Marissa Cole
Staff Engineer, Platform

-------------------------
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-09 09:04 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Interview staffing: succession plan & interviewer shadow rotations

Good plan. I can be on the fallback list for late swaps and can host a quick 15-minute calibration with the backups tomorrow at 11:15 PT to align on scoring and must-have signals.

I'll also add an explicit fallback pool in the calendar invite:
- Vivek Kulkarni
- Priya Natarajan (if available)
- Karthik Iyer (will confirm)

If we do the short calibration we should:
- Agree the 3 nonnegotiable rubric items for hire/no-hire.
- Decide who writes the candidate summary.

Vivek
VP, Engineering

-------------------------
From: Hannah Park <recruiter@talenthq.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Emma Liu <emma.liu@gmail.com>
Date: 2026-10-10 10:22 AM -0700
Subject: Scheduling confirmation for Emma Liu - Senior Infra

Hi Connor and Emma,

Emma is available for the final interview loop on 10/12. She confirmed the 10:00 PT and 2:00 PT slots. She also asked if the loop could be kept to three interviewers if possible.

I'll leave any interviewer swaps up to you; please let me know if you want me to update the candidate comms.

Best,
Hannah Park
Senior Recruiter, TalentHQ

Attachment: EmmaLiu_resume.pdf (pdf, 210KB)

-------------------------
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Park <recruiter@talenthq.com>, Emma Liu <emma.liu@gmail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12 04:42 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling confirmation for Emma Liu - Senior Infra

Thanks, Hannah and Emma. Quick update and plan:

- We will proceed with 3 interviewers on 10/12: Laura (tech deep dive), Marissa (system design), and Connor (team fit + architecture).
- Laura and Marissa did shadow rotations on 10/11 to surface any unknowns. Vivek hosted the 11:15 calibration and we agreed on three rubric items: problem decomposition, design tradeoffs, and operational judgment.
- I attached the panel debrief template and the final shadow schedule.

Emma, we appreciate your flexibility. If anything changes I'll loop you immediately, but we're proceeding as scheduled. Looking forward to the loop.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Hiring Manager, Core Infra
Redwood Inference

Attachments: panel_debrief_template.docx, shadow_schedule_v1.xlsx
